title: The weightStepOpen comment in mappings.ts goes stale once H53+H54 lands: fix it in the next engine-path PR that touches mappings.ts
evidence: packages/health-core/src/mappings.ts:454-456 reads: "The weight step is still open on the saved record: it holds no plausible weight, as computeFormStage reads it, typed and lent values aside. A chat weight is the onboarding's answer only then (US-62 AC31a)." Once H53+H54 lands, the web onboarding chat-weight gate reads the typed box weight, not only saved rows, so "typed and lent values aside" and "only then" stop being true. Fix the comment in the next engine-path PR that touches mappings.ts. (H93)
